newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong crude unit resumes operation.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong crude unit resumes operation.

text.p: South Korea's Ssangyong Oil Refining Co, a unit of Ssangyong Group, resumed operation of its 200,000 barrels per day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) late on Thursday after an 18-day maintenance shutdown, a company spokesman said on Friday.
The unit was closed on September 2, he said.
"We restarted the topper late Thursday night and we expect the unit to run at full capacity by this afternoon," said an official in charge of demand and supply planning at Ssangyong.
The CDU also underwent a brief checkup from May 17 to 21.
Ssangyong, the nation's second largest oil refiner by production, has a crude processing capability of 443,000 bpd.
